# URL Inspector

> Client-side tool to break down, edit, and rebuild URLs without losing encoding, parameter order, duplicate keys, empty values, or fragments.

URL Inspector parses any URL using the RFC 3986 Appendix B grammar, lets users inspect and edit individual components or query parameters, and serializes back losslessly. Everything runs in the browser; inspected URLs never leave the device.

## Pages

- [Inspector](https://urlparts.dev/): Interactive URL tokenizer, component editor, query parameter table, and diagnostics.
- [FAQ](https://urlparts.dev/faq): Answers on URL syntax, percent-encoding, query parameters, and privacy.
- [Sitemap](https://urlparts.dev/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all top-level pages.
